scripts.typecheck: bun --filter '@hexafy/core' typecheck && bun --filter '@hexafy/email' typecheck && bun --filter '@hexafy/aws-lambda' typecheck && bun --filter '@hexafy/nestjs' typecheck && bun --filter '@hexafy/object-storage' typecheck
scripts.build: bun --filter '@hexafy/core' build && bun --filter '@hexafy/email' build && bun --filter '@hexafy/aws-lambda' build && bun --filter '@hexafy/nestjs' build && bun --filter '@hexafy/object-storage' build
scripts.pack:check: rm -rf /tmp/hexafy-packs && mkdir -p /tmp/hexafy-packs && pnpm -r pack --pack-destination /tmp/hexafy-packs && for tgz in /tmp/hexafy-packs/*.tgz; do pnpm exec publint run "$tgz"; pnpm exec attw "$tgz"; done
